title: PITX logs over 1 million passengers ahead of Undas 2026 weekend

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Passenger count at the Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) reached past one million as more Filipinos gear up early for their annual journey back to their home provinces in time for Undas 2026 commemmoration, or the celebration of All Souls’ Day and All Saints’ Day. Based on data released by PITX as of 11 a.m., foot traffic at the terminal stood at 70,275 for Friday morning alone. This brings the total number of passengers who have passed through the terminal from Sunday, Oct. 25, to Friday, Oct. 30, to 1,001,500.
